bibl.title: Wrapped up in the Bible: The Multifaceted Ritual on a Late Antique Amulet (P. Oxy. VIII 1077).
bibl.seg: Joseph E. Sanzo, Wrapped up in the Bible: The Multifaceted Ritual on a Late Antique Amulet (P. Oxy. VIII 1077).
bibl.note: Text and translation of P. Oxy. VIII, 1077 (= van Haelst 341; LDAB 2959). - A brief description of P. Oxy. VIII, 1077. - The human image. - Matt. 4.23-24 in cross formation. - The octagons and the resurrection of Jesus. - Book form and the message of P. Oxy. VIII, 1077. - Ritual efficacy and performative action. - Conclusions.
